items.name: Button
items.description: Solid, outline, soft, ghost and link buttons that light up on hover.

items.name: Input
items.description: Text field with an animated neon focus ring, icons, labels and error states.

items.name: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line field that grows with its content and counts characters.

items.name: Select
items.description: Keyboard-friendly listbox with a glowing popover and typeahead.

items.name: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox with a drawn-on checkmark and indeterminate state.

items.name: Radio Group
items.description: Single choice from a set, with arrow-key navigation and card layouts.

items.name: Switch
items.description: A toggle that powers on like a neon tube.

items.name: Slider
items.description: Pointer and keyboard slider with a glowing track and optional range.

items.name: OTP Input
items.description: One-time code input with auto-advance, paste and backspace handling.

items.name: Toggle Group
items.description: Toggles and segmented controls with a lit pill that slides to the selection.

items.name: Combobox
items.description: Searchable select with filtering, keyboard nav and an async-friendly API.

items.name: Tag Input
items.description: Type, paste or backspace your way through a row of glowing chips.

items.name: Number Input
items.description: Steppers, drag-to-scrub, min, max, step and locale formatting.

items.name: File Dropzone
items.description: Drag files in and the dashed tube border powers up. Lists files with progress.

items.name: Rating
items.description: Stars or bolts that flicker on as you hover, with half steps.

items.name: Color Picker
items.description: Neon gel swatches, a hue knob and a hex field in one control.

items.name: Calendar
items.description: Single, range and multiple selection with full keyboard grid navigation.

items.name: Date Picker
items.description: A field that opens a calendar, with presets and range support.

items.name: Time Input
items.description: Segmented hours and minutes you can type, arrow or scrub.

items.name: Field
items.description: Label, description and error wiring for any control, plus a standalone Label.

items.name: Shimmer Button
items.description: A light sweeps across the face while a beam runs the border.

items.name: Pulse Button
items.description: A ring pulses outward to call attention.

items.name: Magnetic Button
items.description: Pulled toward the cursor, with a label that leads.

items.name: Power Button
items.description: A round power key that ignites with a flickering ring.

items.name: Cyber Button
items.description: Cut corners, a corner tick and a glitch on hover.

items.name: Hold Button
items.description: Hold to confirm: a tube fills, release drains it.

items.name: Copy Button
items.description: Copy to clipboard with a drawn-on check.

items.name: Badge
items.description: Status labels with optional live dot and remove button.

items.name: Avatar
items.description: Profile image with initials fallback, status light and stacked groups.

items.name: Card
items.description: Surface with header, content and footer slots and a lit edge.

items.name: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard keys and shortcuts that glow when pressed.

items.name: Tabs
items.description: Tabbed panels with a sliding light indicator and roving focus.

items.name: Accordion
items.description: Collapsible sections with smooth height animation.

items.name: Table
items.description: Sortable, selectable table with a sticky header and a row hover beam.

items.name: Timeline
items.description: Events on a tube that is lit up to now.

items.name: Glow Chart
items.description: Line, area and bar charts with glow, crosshair tooltips and a Sparkline.

items.name: Breadcrumb
items.description: Path navigation with separators and overflow collapse.

items.name: Pagination
items.description: Page controls with a sliding active indicator and a compact mode.

items.name: Stepper
items.description: Steps joined by a tube that fills as you progress.

items.name: Navigation Menu
items.description: Top navigation with mega-menu panels and a moving light indicator.

items.name: Sidebar
items.description: App sidebar with groups, collapse-to-rail and an active tube marker.

items.name: Dialog
items.description: Accessible modal built on the native dialog element.

items.name: Tooltip
items.description: Hover and focus hints on four sides.

items.name: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Menus with groups, checkable items, submenus and a gliding highlight.

items.name: Context Menu
items.description: Right-click menus built on the Dropdown Menu parts.

items.name: Popover
items.description: Anchored panel that flips to stay on screen, with arrow and focus handling.

items.name: Hover Card
items.description: Rich previews that open on hover or focus.

items.name: Command
items.description: A ⌘K palette with groups, fuzzy search and keyboard navigation.

items.name: Sheet
items.description: Side panel on the native dialog with a lit leading edge.

items.name: Progress
items.description: Linear and circular progress with a moving highlight.

items.name: Spinner
items.description: Ring, dots and bars loaders in any neon color.

items.name: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholders with a scanning shimmer.

items.name: Alert
items.description: Inline messages for info, success, warning and errors.

items.name: Toast
items.description: Stacked notifications with a tiny toast() API. No provider needed.

items.name: Separator
items.description: Hairlines and tube dividers, with optional labels.

items.name: Scroll Area
items.description: Thin neon scrollbar with edge fades that appear only when needed.

items.name: Collapsible
items.description: A single disclosure with smooth height animation.

items.name: Neon Text
items.description: Text rendered as a glowing tube sign, with optional power-on flicker.

items.name: Neon Sign
items.description: A full sign: acrylic backplate, standoffs, frame tube, cable and a power switch with flicker profiles.

items.name: Glitch Text
items.description: RGB-split text with slice jitter, in bursts or on hover.

items.name: Scramble Text
items.description: Text that decodes into place from random glyphs.

items.name: Terminal
items.description: A typing terminal and an inline typewriter for rotating headlines.

items.name: Split-Flap Board
items.description: Departure-board characters that flip mechanically into place.

items.name: Seven-Segment Display
items.description: Numbers and clocks on segments you can see even when they're off.

items.name: LED Matrix
items.description: Dot-matrix marquee with a built-in 5×7 font.

items.name: Knob
items.description: A machined rotary control with a lit value arc and detents.

items.name: Fader
items.description: A mixing-desk channel fader with a scale and an LED meter.

items.name: Hardware Switch
items.description: Rocker, safety-cover flip and key switches you can almost feel.

items.name: Gauge
items.description: Radial gauge with a sprung needle, redline and digital readout.

items.name: Meter
items.description: LED VU meter with zones and peak hold.

items.name: Equalizer
items.description: Animated spectrum bars, optionally driven by real audio.

items.name: Oscilloscope
items.description: A phosphor trace on a CRT grid, from waveforms or live audio.

items.name: Radar
items.description: A sweeping radar where blips flare as the beam passes.

items.name: Heartbeat
items.description: A looping ECG trace with a bright leading edge.

items.name: Countdown
items.description: Launch timers in split-flap, digital or neon-tube digits.

items.name: Neon Clock
items.description: Analog and digital clocks with tube hands and a blinking colon.

items.name: Border Beam
items.description: A beam of light that travels around any element's border.

items.name: Spotlight Card
items.description: Card whose border and surface light up under the cursor.

items.name: Hologram Card
items.description: A 3D-tilting card with iridescent foil and a moving glare.

items.name: Neon Frame
items.description: A HUD frame with corner brackets that draw in and label tabs.

items.name: Tube Divider
items.description: Bent neon tube separators with mounting clips.

items.name: CRT Overlay
items.description: Scanlines, vignette, flicker and a power-on animation over anything.

items.name: Cursor Glow
items.description: A pointer light with an optional comet trail.

items.name: Marquee
items.description: Infinite scrolling rows with edge fades and pause on hover.

items.name: Neon Icon
items.description: Status icons whose bars light in sequence, and any NeonKit icon drawn as a lit tube.

items.name: Retro Grid
items.description: Synthwave perspective grid that scrolls toward the horizon.

items.name: Aurora
items.description: Slow curtains of light drifting behind your content.

items.name: Starfield
items.description: Parallax stars with a hyperspace warp.

items.name: Light Rays
items.description: Volumetric beams with drifting dust.

items.name: Cityscape
items.description: A night skyline with flickering windows and rooftop signs.

items.name: Rain on Glass
items.description: Droplets sliding down glass over neon bokeh.

items.name: Particles
items.description: Drifting dust that reacts to the cursor.

items.name: Alert Dialog
items.description: Confirm dialog on the native dialog element. Cancel takes focus; type-to-confirm lights the action up.

items.name: Drawer
items.description: Bottom drawer with drag to dismiss, snap points, velocity-aware flicks, nesting and a scaled background.

items.name: Menubar
items.description: Application menubar with the APG keyboard model, hover switching, submenus, checkbox and radio items.

items.name: Button Group
items.description: Attached buttons, inputs and text segments with single-pixel seams, split buttons and vertical stacks.

items.name: Input Group
items.description: Input or Textarea with icon, text, button and toolbar addons inside one field box that glows as a whole.

items.name: Item
items.description: List row with media, title, description and actions, for settings, people, files and notifications.

items.name: Empty
items.description: Empty state whose icon is an unlit neon tube that flickers on once there's an action to take.

items.name: Code Block
items.description: Highlighted code with file tabs, line numbers, lit lines, diffs, wrap and copy. Built-in tokenizer, no dependencies.

items.name: Chat Message
items.description: A message row with streamed markdown, reasoning, tool calls, attachments, inline edit and hover actions.

items.name: Prompt Input
items.description: An auto-growing composer with attachments by click, paste or drop, a token counter and a send button that becomes Stop.

items.name: Conversation
items.description: A transcript that follows streaming text, stops when you scroll up and offers Jump to latest with an unread count.

items.name: Reasoning
items.description: A thinking trace with a live line and timer. Its filament glows while it thinks and cools to a dim wire when done.

items.name: Tool Call
items.description: One tool invocation with a status lamp, live timer, arguments, result and Approve/Deny. Groups into a run log.

items.name: Agent Plan
items.description: An agent's steps on a glass tube that fills to the one running. Done, failed and skipped steps, substeps, findings.

items.name: Sources
items.description: Inline citation markers and a source list that light each other, with hover previews of the cited passage.

items.name: Context Meter
items.description: Context-window usage as an LED bar split by system, conversation, files and tools, with zones and a breakdown.

items.name: Voice Input
items.description: Toggle or push-to-talk dictation with a live LED tape from the mic, a timer, cancel and a transcribing state.

items.name: Model Select
items.description: A model picker that prints context, speed and price as LED readouts in columns you can compare.

items.name: Icons
items.description: 310 icons drawn as bent neon tube, with lucide-compatible names and props. Blockout gaps where one tube passes behind another.

items.name: Data Table
items.description: Sorting with Shift multi-sort, search, faceted filters, range selection, pages or load more. No table library.

items.name: Tree View
items.description: File tree with the APG keyboard model, typeahead, multi-select, lazy folders and a lit guide down the open branch.

items.name: Resizable
items.description: Resizable panel groups: nested, collapsible, keyboard-driven, saved to localStorage. Grips light up as tubes.

items.name: Carousel
items.description: Scroll-snap carousel with mouse drag, loop, autoplay that pauses itself, and dots that fill with the timer.

items.name: Stat
items.description: KPI with a count-up value, a tube-drawn icon that lights when live, a delta judged by direction, a sparkline or goal.

items.name: Donut Chart
items.description: Donut and pie charts bent from neon tube, with a lit hover, keyboard reading and an unlit remainder for max.

items.name: Odometer
items.description: Rolling-drum counter that carries like real gearing. Lit, backlit and cream drums, locale-aware separators.

items.name: Status Light
items.description: Indicator lamp with six states: a bezelled panel LED, a dot or a live pulse, plus a group for service lists.

items.name: Dock
items.description: Magnifying dock on springs, with tooltips, running tubes, badges, separators and a one-stop keyboard toolbar.

items.name: Image Compare
items.description: Before and after slider split by a lit tube. Drag, press, keys or hover to scrub; horizontal or vertical.

items.name: Banner
items.description: Announcement bar with a tube along its bottom edge that strikes on at mount. Remembers dismissal, can scroll.

blocks.name: Minimal Navbar
blocks.description: Quiet navbar with a lit tube under the active link and a large-type mobile sheet.

blocks.name: Mega Menu Navbar
blocks.description: Mega menu with a live CI pipeline readout and a collapsible mobile sheet.

blocks.name: Floating Navbar
blocks.description: Floating pill nav that tightens on scroll and grows a glowing reading-progress hairline.

blocks.name: Grid Hero
blocks.description: Retro-grid hero with a working email capture and a live webhook delivery log.

blocks.name: Terminal Hero
blocks.description: Split hero where a typing terminal deploys, then 38 region bars light up on success.

blocks.name: City Hero
blocks.description: Night-skyline launch hero with a neon-tube countdown and a notify-me form.

blocks.name: Product Hero
blocks.description: Centered hero over a tilted, interactive analytics dashboard with light pooling beneath.

blocks.name: Split Form Hero
blocks.description: Split hero with a working email, OTP and vault-created sign-up flow.

blocks.name: Bento Features
blocks.description: Live bento of meters, a threshold knob, latency readout, ECG watchdog and terminal.

blocks.name: Alternating Features
blocks.description: Three alternating rows of live UI: invoice search, due-date calendar, bank reconcile.

blocks.name: Spotlight Features
blocks.description: Spotlight cards where the number is the hero and lights up like a tube on hover.

blocks.name: Before and After
blocks.description: Before and after columns; a rocker switch powers the lit column's checks in sequence.

blocks.name: Feature Steps
blocks.description: Three working steps joined by a Stepper tube that fills as each one completes.

blocks.name: Logo Grid
blocks.description: A hairline grid of twelve type-drawn wordmarks that flicker on like signs when hovered.

blocks.name: Logo Marquee
blocks.description: A logo marquee under a strip lamp: each wordmark lights up as it passes the middle.

blocks.name: Stat Counters
blocks.description: Seven-segment stats that count up in view, led by a live requests-served counter.

blocks.name: Stats with Chart
blocks.description: Uptime KPIs and a glowing p95 chart with an SLO line and a 7/30/90-day range switch.

blocks.name: Testimonial Wall
blocks.description: A masonry wall of twelve quotes with one lit featured card and a show-all toggle.

blocks.name: Testimonial Marquee
blocks.description: Two opposing quote marquees; hovering a card pauses it and lights its highlighted line.

blocks.name: Big Quote
blocks.description: An editorial big quote signed with a neon name sign that re-strikes per story.

blocks.name: Pricing Tiers
blocks.description: Three plans with an odometer price roll on billing switch and a beamed featured tier.

blocks.name: Single Plan
blocks.description: One plan with a lit price driven by a pageview slider and an honest not-included list.

blocks.name: Plan Comparison
blocks.description: Full plan comparison table with tooltips, grouped rows and a sticky lit plan header.

blocks.name: FAQ Accordion
blocks.description: Two-column FAQ: an Accordion whose open answer lights a tube, plus a support card.

blocks.name: Searchable FAQ
blocks.description: Command-powered FAQ search with grouped topics and a lit answer panel.

blocks.name: CTA Band
blocks.description: Full-width call to action between two neon tubes that strike as it scrolls in.

blocks.name: Open Sign CTA
blocks.description: An OPEN neon sign on a brick wall; flip the switch and the CTA lights up.

blocks.name: Install Command CTA
blocks.description: Big headline over a glowing install prompt with a package-manager switch.

blocks.name: Big Footer
blocks.description: Link columns, newsletter and status, over a giant outlined name that lights up.

blocks.name: Minimal Footer
blocks.description: One calm row under a thin neon tube with electrode caps.

blocks.name: Sign Footer
blocks.description: A neon sign signature over a city skyline, with address and live opening hours.

blocks.name: Sign In
blocks.description: Split sign-in with an orbiting satellite over a lit planet limb and a working form.

blocks.name: Sign Up
blocks.description: Sign-up form whose LED strength meter and rule tubes light as the password improves.

blocks.name: Two-Factor Verify
blocks.description: OTP check with a resend timer and a neon keystone that lights on success, red on failure.

blocks.name: Dashboard
blocks.description: Metrics dashboard with a rail sidebar, a glowing MRR chart and a sortable accounts table.

blocks.name: Settings
blocks.description: Tabbed settings with a save bar that lights on changes and a hold-to-delete danger zone.

blocks.name: Inbox
blocks.description: Three-pane mail client with glowing unread dots, labels, archive, reply and compose.

blocks.name: Kanban Board
blocks.description: Production board where cards fly between columns and WIP limits buzz red when exceeded.

blocks.name: Team Chat
blocks.description: Team chat with grouped messages, a working composer, glowing typing dots and replies.

blocks.name: Notification Center
blocks.description: Incident notification center with filters, day groups and a lit firing-alert detail pane.

blocks.name: Music Player
blocks.description: Now-playing radio screen with SVG tube cover art, a live Equalizer, fader volume and queue.

blocks.name: Status Board
blocks.description: Status board with a fleet Heartbeat, live load meters, 90-day uptime bars and an incident Timeline.

blocks.name: Onboarding
blocks.description: Three-step workspace setup with a Stepper and a live preview that retints to the chosen accent.

blocks.name: Empty States
blocks.description: Four empty states with unlit glass tube illustrations that light on hover or success.

blocks.name: 404 No Vacancy
blocks.description: Full-page 404 under a motel sign whose 0 is dying, with key-fob links to popular pages.

blocks.name: 500 Power Outage
blocks.description: Browned-out 500 page; flip the breaker panel's main switch to bring the lights back.

blocks.name: Newsletter
blocks.description: Newsletter capture card lit by a desk-lamp tube, with an expandable issue archive.

blocks.name: Waitlist
blocks.description: Waitlist that hands you a split-flap ticket number and a referral link to copy.

blocks.name: Team Grid
blocks.description: Team grid of hologram ID cards, each with a lit tide line, plus filters and open roles.

blocks.name: Contact
blocks.description: Contact form with validation and studio hours on a live seven-segment clock.

blocks.name: Changelog
blocks.description: Release notes on a tube timeline lit from the newest version, with tag filters.

blocks.name: Blog Grid
blocks.description: Featured post and filterable card grid with blueprint covers, each with one lit stroke.

blocks.name: Event Ticket
blocks.description: Notched event ticket with a neon wordmark, seeded QR stub, countdown and wallet button.

blocks.name: Product Card
blocks.description: Product card with an exploding isometric switch lit in its stem color, plus a live cart.
